topic: Dot Products and the Concept of Duality

sections.title: Prerequisite: Projective Intuition
lecture_lines: Vector A casts a shadow on vector B.
This shadow length signifies the projection.
animations: Draw vector A (#FF0000) and vector B (#0000FF). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sun.svg]
Create a perpendicular line from tip of A to B (#FFFFFF).
Draw the projection segment on vector B (#FFFF00). [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/flashlight.svg]

sections.title: Defining the Dot Product as a Linear Map
lecture_lines: Dot product is a linear map.
It returns a scalar from two vectors.
A fixed vector w defines this function.
animations: Display formula f(v) = w dot v (#FFFFFF).
Animate v moving across output mapping (#00FF00).

sections.title: The Core Concept: Duality
lecture_lines: Duality connects vectors to linear functionals.
The dot product acts as a bridge.
Every functional corresponds to a vector.
animations: Visualize vector v as an arrow (#FF0000) with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Draw the linear functional coordinate line (#00FF00).
Show dot product interaction between v and functional (#FFFFFF).
Display duality transform mapping vector to functional (#FFFF00).

sections.title: Visualizing Duality via Level Sets
lecture_lines: Dot product defines perpendicular level sets.
Level sets map the dual space.
animations: Draw parallel lines for constant dot product (#FFFFFF).
Place vector w perpendicular to sets (#FF0000) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/plane.svg].
Animate constant c to move level sets (#00FF00).

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: Vectors are points, duals are tools.
Dot product bridges geometry and functions.
animations: Display vector space and dual side by side (#FFFFFF).
Highlight dot product connecting the two worlds (#FF0000).
Show unification of vector and operational functions (#FFFF00).
